title: 2 Trending Open Source SQL Tools Developers Are Loving  #github
description:
Today, I’m introducing two open-source SQL tools that are blowing up right now.

One lets you connect to almost any database from your terminal in seconds.

https://github.com/Maxteabag/sqlit

The other lets you write SQL queries using class names inside React Server Components.

https://github.com/mmarinovic/tailwindsql

#github #opensource
